title: Isolated local and test service infrastructure

target_symbols.reason: Provides loopback-only developer services without touching host ports already in use.
Rejects any database target that is not the explicit EstateFlow test database.

constraints: Bind every service port to 127.0.0.1 only.
Do not use host ports 5432 or 6379 because they are occupied.
Local and test database names, credentials, volumes, compose project names, and ports must differ.
No real credentials, customer data, application schema, migrations, or deployment.
acceptance: Both compose configurations validate and start their own healthy PostGIS and Redis services.
PostGIS extension is enabled by init SQL in each database.
The destructive-test guard rejects local/non-test URLs and accepts only explicit loopback estateflow_test URLs with opt-in.
Both compose stacks are removed after verification without touching unrelated host services.
